description: Land Acquisition - Deddugoda (North), Dangedara (East), Deddugoda (South), Makuluwa, Medawalamulla (South), Magalle, Maligaspe, Milidduwa, Pettigalawatta, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of 370 land lots with their boundaries, extents, and location details. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition of property) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
